title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.2
text: New beeps now pop a card by the slime (click it to reply), your chats stay after you log out, and ⚙ can turn on desktop notifications.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.3
text: 🌙 Night mode with a night blue slime (thanks Alyx!), SlimeBeep in Settings > Extensions, and this little note in the room chat after every update.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.3.1
text: SlimeBeep's page in Settings > Extensions now looks like the game's other settings pages.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.3.2
text: Beeps that another extension (like EBC) handles first now show up in SlimeBeep too.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.4
text: 👥 Group chats with other SlimeBeep users, up to 40 people! Make one from 💬 Chats. Owners and admins run them, and the group can let everyone invite. Beeps another extension grabs first now reach SlimeBeep too.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.5
text: 🖼 Profile pictures! Pick yours in ⚙ and your SlimeBeep friends see it in chats, friends and group chats.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.5.1
text: Fixed: beeps no longer show bits like {"messageType":...} on R132, and other extensions' hidden signals (like ReqRoom) no longer show up as beeps.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.5.2
text: Other extensions' hidden signals (like KIKILINK) are no longer shown as beeps, and short beeps like <3 or hi always come through.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.6
text: New tabs: 👥 Groups for your group chats, and 🌊 WaveBeep (the old Group tab) to send one beep to many friends.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.7
text: 🐞 New Bug tab: tell SlimeQueenSamantha what went wrong, and SlimeBeep adds the details that help fix it. Making a group chat is easier too: tick friends, the name is optional.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.7.1
text: Update notes like this one now show up reliably in the room chat after each update.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.8
text: 👥 Group chats now work with anyone who has SlimeBeep, friends or not (join with a code), and you see what you missed while offline. Online/offline dots in groups, and offline friends in 💖. Old group chats from before can't come along, sorry: make a new one!

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.8.1
text: Updates now reach you faster, and SlimeBeep copes better when Bondage Club updates.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.9
text: Other add-ons (like CRABS) can now work together with SlimeBeep, for example to see who is in your SlimeBeep group chats.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.10
text: Other add-ons can now open a chat with someone or invite them to your group chats straight from their own buttons.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.10.1
text: You can now invite any friend to a group chat: friends without SlimeBeep get a beep with the code and where to get it.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.11
text: Using Themed or BCNeko? SlimeBeep can now match your theme's colours: turn it on in Settings > Extensions > SlimeBeep.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.12
text: ⏳ Beep friends who are offline: it waits and sends when they're back. And WaveBeep has 📍 My room, to beep just the friends in your room.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.13
text: ✨ *giggles* and other actions now show in italics in your chats and group chats.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.14
text: 🖼 Fit your profile picture in the circle (drag and zoom), see yours in the header, and click anyone's picture to see it big. 📍 Beeps from a room now have a Join button that really takes you there.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.14.2
text: Fitting your profile picture now happens inside the SlimeBeep window instead of covering the whole game, and it closes with ✕, Cancel, Escape or a click beside it.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.14.3
text: 🖼 Sharper profile pictures (128×128, choose yours again to upgrade it), and the picture now sits right inside the circle when you fit it.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.15
text: ⏻ Need a break? The ⏻ button in SlimeBeep's header turns it off until you reload (it asks first).

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.15.1
text: ⏻ now asks before turning SlimeBeep off, and warns that you'll need to reload and click your SlimeBeep bookmark to get it back.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.16
text: 🚪 Leaving a group chat is clearer (the 🚪 at the top of the chat), and owners can now delete their group for everyone.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.17
text: 😊 Emoji picker in every chat, and commands: /me, /shrug, /roll, /flip, /help. Fixed: typing in the room chat could jump into SlimeBeep and get sent from there.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.18
text: 🖼 Group chats can have a picture (admins: 👥 page). Links in chats are clickable, and a group code gets a Join button, in SlimeBeep and in the room chat. Friendlier invite beeps. Fixed: the slime could move by itself after a drag.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.18.1
text: Fixed: group chats couldn't be joined or made when the game was opened on a plain http:// address (like the mirrors). They work there now.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.18.2
text: Group chats now work from the bondageeurope.com mirror too. Invite beeps no longer mention FUSAM (SlimeBeep isn't on it yet).

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.19
text: 📬 Beeps to an offline friend with SlimeBeep now wait in their mailbox and reach them when they log in, even if you've gone. 🔕 Mute any chat or group with the 🔔 at its top.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.19.1
text: Small tidy-up under the hood: SlimeBeep starts a little faster when loaded from its own site. Nothing to do on your side.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 2.19.2
text: Group invites to friends without SlimeBeep are now a plain beep with the code (no link), and go 3 at a time.

title: 🎉 SlimeBeep 3.0
text: SlimeBeep 3.0: the official launch! Chats, group chats with pictures, mailboxes for offline friends, WaveBeep, mute, emoji and more. Thank you for testing it with me 💖

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.1
text: Tidier code under the hood. If you open the game on a plain http:// address, SlimeBeep now points you to the https one for group chats.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.2
text: Behind the scenes: every update is now checked for mistakes automatically before it goes out, so things break less. Nothing changes for you.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.3
text: Fixes: the invite list no longer jumps back to the top (and keeps who you ticked), a bigger back arrow, centred header buttons, the slime no longer jumps to the bottom when dragged past the top, and a tidier SlimeBeep page in Settings > Extensions. SlimeBeep is now in FUSAM's Addon Manager (as beta)!

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.4
text: The window is now its own window: drag it by its top bar and resize it from any edge or corner (double-click an edge for the usual size, ⚙ Put it back resets everything). Group messages no longer show up in one-to-one chats, invites from friends you never beeped arrive, buttons are centred everywhere, and the picture buttons in ⚙ fit.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.5
text: BCT's behind-the-scenes beeps (like "Friends" between best friends) no longer show up as messages in your chats.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.6
text: Group invites now go as a normal beep with a Join button, so you can see them in your chat too, and they arrive the same way your beeps do. Send invites tells you how it went, and ⚙'s pop-up setting has a clearer name. Night mode no longer tints profile pictures, and "Let them join me" now starts off for new players.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.7
text: 🎵 A music player: press 🎵, paste a YouTube or mp3 link and listen, with a queue and your own volume. Share it in a chat and friends can listen along in time with you. Picture and GIF links now show the picture (sites SlimeBeep doesn't know ask first), and reading older messages no longer jumps you down: Jump to present takes you back.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.8
text: Closing the music player now just hides it and the music keeps playing; 🎵 glows while a song plays, so you can bring the player back or pause it.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.0.9
text: If something like NoScript or a strict blocker stops group chats from connecting, SlimeBeep now says so and names the address to allow.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.1
text: Increased security, and your profile picture now stays with your own account when you play several in one browser.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.1.1
text: 🤫 Whispers in a chat room now show in that person's chat too, and while you're in the same room, replying from there whispers back.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.1.2
text: 🔕 Do not disturb is in the top bar now: one tap and SlimeBeep makes no sounds or pop-ups (messages still arrive). Quit moved to ⚙ Options.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.2
text: ⚙ now opens SlimeBeep's page in the game's Settings, with every option in one place. Actions read like in the game: *waves or /me waves shows as *Name waves*. Esc closes the window. New beeps and notes now pop as the game's own notifications, in SlimeBeep's colours.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.2.1
text: 🎧 Listen along stays in time with the host much more closely, and starts where they are. Everyone listening can add songs to the host's queue and skip their own, and small pictures show who is listening. 💬 Tap your picture at the top to set a status, like on Discord; it can show the song you're listening to.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.2.2
text: 🏆 Achievements! Slime someone, keep the Slime Queen company, start a jam… (and a few secrets). Your friends see your trophies. 🌐 Translate any message with a tap, or a whole chat by itself (it follows CATS if you have it). Chats now show who is offline with a grey dot.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.2.3
text: Fewer pop-ups: after an update you get just this one note, even if you skipped a version, and you can turn it off in Settings > Extensions > SlimeBeep ("Tell me what's new after an update"). Night mode now also darkens the status, achievements and other small windows.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.2.4
text: No more "✓ Beep sent" pop-up every time you send a beep: it's already in the chat. A WaveBeep still tells you when it's done if you've closed the panel.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.3
text: 🏆 More achievements: The Cabaret, Care for a Drink?, A Treat for the Road, Secured, a new secret one, and two that only show if you use Echo's Clothing Mod or LSCG. Tap 🏆 in 💖 to see them.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.4
text: 💤 AFK: click 💤 at the top of SlimeBeep, write your auto-reply, and anyone who beeps or whispers you gets it (once every 10 minutes each) until you click 💤 again. It doesn't change your status.

title: 📢 SlimeBeep 3.5
text: Delete single messages, clear a chat, pin your favourite chats. Point at a message (or tap it) for its 🗑; the ⋯ at the top of a chat pins it or clears it. Deleting is just for you: the others keep their copy.
